entries.risk_area: Subprocess Command Injection & Executable Path Validation
entries.evidence: ClaudeCLISession launches the claude CLI using Foundation Process with explicit URL, argument array ([String]), and environment dictionary. No shell command string interpolation is used. ClaudeLocator enforces file ownership and POSIX permission checks (mode 0o755/0o700, parent folder non-world-writable) on custom executable overrides.

Reviewed LinkHost.swift in detail. Enforces mutual HMAC-SHA256 handshake and ChaCha20Poly1305 frame AEAD encryption with 64-bit sequence counters. Pre-auth limits cap global pre-auth at 8 and per-peer at 3 with 10s timeouts. Max 3 connections per device. Approval authorization rules enforce presentation checks, truncation limits, device biometrics for high-risk requests, and stale request expiration (300s).

PermissionPolicy and FolderGrants use symlink-resolved path canonicalization (resolvingSymlinksInPath) to prevent traversal. Folder grants for shell commands strictly disqualify commands containing variables, command substitution ($ or backticks), inline code interpreters (python -c, node -e), or redirection operators.

KeychainStore saves Anthropic API keys in the macOS Keychain with kSecAttrAccessibleWhenUnlocked. Device keys are stored in Keychain or 0600 file stores. LogRedactor scrubs API keys, bearer tokens, emails, and usernames before diagnostic export. Gitleaks and Trufflehog confirmed 0 secrets in product code.

entries.risk_area: Permission policy risk classification & voice approval guardrails
entries.evidence: Reviewed PermissionPolicy.swift. Risk classification correctly categorizes tools, file writes, and bash commands. Protected folders (PairVox settings & Claude config) are rated high risk. MCP tools force screen confirmation. Risk level low/medium/high and voice approvability logic verified.

entries.risk_area: Directory access control, symlink traversal, & shell auto-approval scope
entries.evidence: Reviewed FolderGrants.swift and FolderScope. FolderScope.resolved() recursively resolves symlinks up to 32 depth (falling back to unresolvable). Shell grants strictly disqualify command variables, backticks, globs, redirects, and cd leaving the folder.

entries.risk_area: Voice command processing, prompt echo cancellation, and permission queue timing
entries.evidence: Reviewed ConversationEngine.swift. Timestamps verify voice answers occurred after prompt playback started. Echo detection prevents application from approving its own prompt audio. Remote commands from phone link disable permission approval capability. Single-request queue prevents batch approvals.

entries.risk_area: Advisor subprocess sandboxing & prompt injection fence isolation
entries.evidence: Reviewed ClaudeAdvisor.swift and RequestAdvisor.swift. Subprocess sandboxed with --tools Read,Grep,Glob and all write/eval/network tools disallowed. Empty MCP config enforced. Prompts sanitized via fenceSafe() to break prompt injection delimiters.

entries.risk_area: Device Secret Key Storage, Keychain Access, and Distribution Build Isolation
entries.evidence: Reviewed DeviceKeyStore.swift. KeychainDeviceKeyStore uses kSecAttrAccessibleAfterFirstUnlockThisDeviceOnly without iCloud sync. FileDeviceKeyStore uses 0700 dir, 0600 file permissions, atomic file replacement, and Time Machine exclusion. Distribution builds force Keychain storage. Legacy import marker prevents planted key attacks.

entries.risk_area: Subprocess execution isolation, environment variable filtering, & executable path verification
entries.evidence: Reviewed ClaudeCLISession.swift, ChildEnvironment.swift, LaunchConfiguration.swift, and ClaudeLocator.swift. ChildEnvironment filters ANTHROPIC_*, CLAUDE_CODE_*, NODE_OPTIONS, and TLS manipulation variables. Untrusted project configuration is disabled by default (--setting-sources user). Executable path overrides enforce permissions and ownership checks.

entries.risk_area: Device Pairing Protocol, HMAC Proof Verification, & Anti-Bruteforce Controls
entries.evidence: Reviewed Pairing.swift. Offers use 128-bit random secrets valid for 120s. Proofs use constant-time HMAC-SHA256 comparison. Device names sanitized against control/newlines/bidi injection. Anti-bruteforce caps wrong attempts at 3 per peer and 12 total. Grants delivered via ChaCha20Poly1305 sealed boxes with Mac user approval gate.

entries.risk_area: Configuration persistence, settings file permission validation, & system prompt configuration
entries.evidence: Reviewed SystemPrompts.swift, Settings.swift, and SettingsStore. SystemPrompts.voice configures Claude Code system prompt. SettingsStore loads AppSettings and validates file ownership/permissions to prevent untrusted files from setting executable path overrides or standing grants.

entries.risk_area: Engine Link Proxying & Permission Approval Delegation
entries.evidence: Reviewed EngineLink.swift. Approvals from remote devices pass always=false to prevent persistent policy overrides. Transcripts are bounded to 40 items. Sentences and playback audio remain on the Mac.

entries.evidence: Executed swift test (failed with swift command not found due to missing Swift toolchain in Linux container). Reviewed SecurityHardeningTests, PolicyAndCommandTests, FolderGrantTests, and CLISessionTests. entries.risk_area: Local IPC Socket Control & Peer UID Authorization
entries.evidence: Reviewed LinkCommands.swift. Unix domain socket is created in 0700 folder with 0600 permissions. Connections verify getpeereid peer UID matches getuid(). Socket timeouts (2s) and SO_NOSIGPIPE prevent local IPC denial of service.

Reviewed TailnetAddress.swift. Listener and peer validation strictly enforce Tailscale CGNAT IP ranges (100.64.0.0/10 IPv4, fd7a:115c:a1e0::/48 IPv6) on utun interfaces or loopback (127.0.0.1 / ::1), preventing interface exposure on public LANs.
